title: Bad Bunny Attends 2026 Met Gala — "Costume Art" Theme, Fifth Consecutive Appearance
detail: Bad Bunny attends the 2026 Met Gala at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City on May 4, 2026 — his fifth consecutive appearance at fashion's biggest night since his debut in 2022. The event's theme, "Costume Art," challenges attendees to transform their bodies into living canvases at the intersection of fashion history and artistic tradition. He had kept a deliberately low profile in New York City since arriving on April 30, spotted in casual attire (gray hoodie, jeans, green cap) by Just Jared. His appearance comes at the peak of a historic career run: "DtMF" has just set the all-time record of 57 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart (chart dated May 2, 2026) — the longest No. 1 run in the chart's 60+ year history, surpassing Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee's "Despacito." The European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opens in Barcelona (Estadi Olímpic) on May 22, 2026, with two sold-out nights in Barcelona, then Lisbon (May 26–27 at Estádio da Luz), followed by 10 sold-out nights in Madrid.
